components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The square, navy action used for creating and committing changes.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 46px; padding: 12px 18px; color: var(--paper, #f5f8f6); background: var(--navy, #102735); border: 0; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-weight: 700; transition: background 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--coast, #397079); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #ef704f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--navy, #102735); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered cancel or alternative action that stays subordinate to the primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 17px; color: var(--navy, #102735); background: transparent; border: 1px solid #94aaa4; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-weight: 700; transition: background 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--mist, #d7e3df); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #ef704f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #c9d7d2; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: The confirmed destructive action, never a routine row action.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 17px; color: #fff; background: var(--danger, #a43e32); border: 0; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-weight: 700; transition: filter 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter: brightness(0.9); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #ef704f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { filter: brightness(0.82); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A square, high-contrast field for canonical search criteria.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--navy, #102735); font-family: "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field input { min-height: 43px; padding: 9px 11px; color: var(--ink, #172126); background: #fff; border: 1px solid #9db1ab; border-radius: 0; caret-color: var(--signal, #ef704f); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--coast, #397079); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #ef704f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selected Choice Chip
components.description: A square selected option for fuel or transmission constraints.
components.css: .ds-choice-chip { padding: 8px 10px; color: var(--paper, #f5f8f6); background: var(--coast, #397079); border: 1px solid var(--coast, #397079); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.71rem; } .ds-choice-chip:hover { filter: brightness(0.94); } .ds-choice-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #ef704f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-choice-chip:active { filter: brightness(0.86); }

components.name: Active State Badge
components.description: A read-only pill that pairs state color with a literal label.
components.css: .ds-state-badge { display: inline-flex; gap: 7px; align-items: center; padding: 5px 9px; color: #166142; background: #dceee5; border-radius: 999px; font-family: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.63rem; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-state-badge i { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: var(--success, #27875d); border-radius: 50%; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: The navy shell navigation with a coral current-location signal.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 7px; padding: 24px; color: #bdceca; background: var(--navy, #102735); font-family: "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-nav a, .ds-nav span { position: relative; padding: 9px 0 9px 18px; color: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::before, .ds-nav span::before { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0; width: 5px; height: 5px; background: #5f7b80; border-radius: 50%; content: ""; transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: #fff; } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]::before { background: var(--signal, #ef704f); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(239,112,79,.15); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #ef704f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav span[aria-disabled="true"] { color: #70898d; }

components.css: .ds-search-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 92px minmax(220px, 1fr) minmax(160px, .55fr); min-height: 150px; color: var(--ink, #172126); background: rgba(245,248,246,.93); border-top: 3px solid var(--navy, #102735); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #b8c8c3); font-family: "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: background 180ms ease-out; } .ds-search-row:hover { background: #fff; } .ds-priority { display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--paper, #f5f8f6); background: var(--navy, #102735); font-family: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 1.4rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-record { padding: 28px 32px; border-right: 1px solid #d2ded9; } .ds-record h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--navy, #102735); font-family: "Arial Narrow", "Aptos Narrow", "Roboto Condensed", sans-serif; font-size: 1.8rem; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-record p { margin: 20px 0 0; color: #41545b; font-size: .88rem; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-search-row dl { display: grid; align-content: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 26px; } .ds-search-row dt { color: #74847f; font-family: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace; font-size: .63rem; } .ds-search-row dd { margin: 0; color: var(--success, #27875d); font-size: .76rem; }

narrative.overview:
Dealfinder feels like a private operational ledger: quiet enough for sustained desktop work, exact enough for consequential search criteria, and local rather than corporate. Navy framing establishes the control desk; cool paper surfaces and a faint 28px ruling keep the workspace legible and tactile without turning it decorative.

The interface is dense but not compressed. Large condensed headings establish location, monospace labels carry machine state and measured values, and ordinary body copy remains calm and readable. Sharp dividers, flat surfaces, and a meaningful priority spine organize the work; signal coral is reserved for focus, capacity, priority, and states that deserve attention.
keyCharacteristics: Navy shell around a cool ruled-paper workspace.
Condensed display type paired with practical sans-serif body copy and monospace telemetry.
Flat, square operational surfaces separated by lines rather than cards and shadows.
A dark priority spine that makes ordering part of the information architecture.
Coral signal marks used sparingly for consequential state and interaction.

rules.name: The Signal Means Something Rule
rules.body: Use coral only for focus, priority, capacity, hard constraints, loading, or attention; it is not a general decoration color.

rules.name: The State Colors Stay Literal Rule
rules.body: Green confirms readiness, ochre asks for caution, and brick marks error or destruction. Do not exchange those meanings.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Condensed type names the work, body type explains it, and monospace type reports state or measurements.

rules.name: The Ruled Surface Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with grid tracks and 1px dividers; reserve the 3px navy rule for the beginning of a ledger or empty-state region.

rules.name: The Flat Until Modal Rule
rules.body: Rows, controls, and status rails stay shadowless; only overlays receive structural elevation.

rules.name: The Curves Carry State Rule
rules.body: Rounded shapes identify status, toggles, orbit imagery, or the mark; they do not soften ordinary containers.

dos: Do preserve the navy frame, cool paper field, and flat ruled-ledger construction when extending the application.
Do keep coral rare and attach it to focus, priority, capacity, hard constraints, loading, or attention.
Do use the priority spine when ordering is part of the operator's decision model.
Do keep labels visible, focus rings explicit, numerals comparable, and reduced-motion behavior intact.
Do collapse grids at the established 1180px, 900px, 700px, and 440px breakpoints according to content pressure.
donts: Don't introduce rounded cards, soft floating panels, or decorative shadows into the base workspace.
Don't use signal coral as a broad brand wash or routine hover color.
Don't replace dividers and grid tracks with isolated dashboard tiles.
Don't use display type for explanatory copy or monospace type for long prose.
Don't hide consequential state inside color alone; pair it with a label, message, or icon.
